mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or HOUST increases do not correlate with subsequent economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% MoM signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM > 2% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decreases > 25bps do not correlate with subsequent loosening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS > 200,000 does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 0.5% MoM and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% MoM and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a contractionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.
